name: LeForge
description: Run LeForge actions and publish Fabric events from a workflow
summary: LeForge REST calls from a workflow. Built from the LeForge usertasks-connectors repository.
setup_notes: Packaged for one LeForge server (npm run package -- leforge --url <server URL>). Set the secret "api_token" on the Access tab: A LeForge API key. It starts with fhk_. Create it in LeForge under Settings, API keys. An API key made for this workflow engine only Scope actions:read to list actions. The connection test also needs it. The scope of each action the workflow runs Scope fabric:publish to publish Fabric events
author: LeForge
